blocks.text: WASHINGTON — US President Donald Trump on Tuesday urged Volodymyr Zelensky to make a deal with Russia — redoubling pressure on the Ukrainian leader even as Moscow grinds on with the war it launched four years ago. Trump also said he had asked Russian President Vladimir Putin to release Stephen Hubbard — an American taken captive by Moscow’s forces years earlier in Ukraine — in a fresh sign of his pivot back to Moscow. “We want Zelensky to make a deal.
